a11y.accessibleName: The associated label. Placeholder text is never a substitute.
notes: label/for, hint and error ids are derived from the field name so they always agree.
The error message renders above the control: a screen reader reaches it before editing, and a mobile keyboard cannot cover it.
aria-invalid is set only when there is an error. Present-and-false on every field is noise.
The error text carries a visually hidden 'Error:' prefix, so meaning does not rest on the red styling.

docs.summary: A labelled text input with hint and error support.
whenToUse: Collecting a single line of text.
whenNotToUse: Choosing from a fixed list. Use Select.
